expectation: Membrane ring stain on a subset of CD68+ macrophages, as scattered single cells or clusters in stroma and myeloid-rich areas. Absent from tumour or epithelial cells and lymphoid areas. Moderate frequency.
observed: A: many cores show discrete yellow cells, some clustered. Others are near empty, and B and C are mostly empty with sparse streaks. D: crisp membrane rings around blue nuclei. E1: bright membrane rings in cell clusters, with dark tissue between. E3: CD163 lies on a subset of CD68+ cells, plus some CD163-only cells.
why: A distinct population of cells with membrane rings that overlap a subset of CD68+ macrophages and cluster in myeloid-rich areas, with clean negative tissue elsewhere.
notes: CD163 shows clear membrane rings on discrete clustered cells, and these overlap a subset of CD68+ macrophages. Many cores and fields B and C are mostly negative, as expected for a macrophage subset.
